result.detail: Attempt 2 was refused because it listed run-0001 as its own tool run. tool_runs is now empty, and run-0001 is cited only as the record of the earlier failure. For attempt 1's missing verdict, this testbench prints the verdict exactly once, from either the normal end of the test or a watchdog at 2 ms, and always ends with $finish (never $fatal). The main open risk is how the nonce is delivered. If the platform passes it some other way (for example a define or a different plusarg name), the verdict line will carry 'none'. In that case, please tell me the mechanism through the escalation path (verification.dynamic.testbench.tech_lead). One gap: the reset of each source's remembered level (src_q, IRQ-RESET) cannot be observed through the ports, because reset also clears MODE to level-triggered. It is therefore not checked directly.; submitted on attempt 3, after prj-486b52a6aa:testbench#t1, prj-486b52a6aa:testbench#t2
